name: @mattbusel/llm-prices
description: Dated, source-cited LLM API prices (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Groq, Together, Fireworks, Cohere, Amazon Bedrock, OpenRouter, Perplexity) per 1M tokens, with provider-aware model-id lookup and exact decimal costs. Zero dependencies.
author: Matthew Busel

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/lookup.test.mjs test/cost.test.mjs test/cjs.test.cjs
